fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious patterns in program names or folders that are often found in malicious samples or hacktools
fields.name: Suspicious Program Names
fields.notes:
- To move around freely without attracting too much attention, attackers often use reliable software (one of the favorites is psexec) that looks normal in an enterprise environment.
- Use the following aggregate to easily group by endpoint: `| group array_agg_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, src.process.cmdline`
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\CVE-202" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\CVE202") or (tgt.process.image.path contains "\poc.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\artifact.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\artifact64.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\artifact_protected.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\artifact32.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\artifact32big.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "obfuscated.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains or tgt.process.cmdline contains "payload.ps1" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "beacon.ps1" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "PowerView.ps1" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "bypass.ps1" or
